verdict.rationale: All flights meet the stated post-call departure constraint and arrive the evening before the required 7:00 a.m. badge-in. C is cheapest but has the shortest connection; D has the earliest arrival and longest connection but costs the most; A and B offer intermediate price, arrival, and connection-time tradeoffs. Selecting a lead requires unstated priorities such as minimizing cost, favoring a longer connection for reliability, preferring SFO versus OAK, or avoiding Southwest open seating.
